standard.$description: CSS `ease`: small fades of color and turns of a chevron.

settle.$description: Quick, then slow: a screen, a card or a row settling into place.

overshoot.$description: Overshoots and settles back: a check popping, a card landing. Where `dev.westron.spring` is given, platforms with springs use the spring instead.

overshoot-soft.$description: A smaller overshoot: a popover or a row appearing.
